transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah, good to meet you. I, uh... I guess I'm just having some trouble on the job lately. Driving. 

Over the last few months, my mind just... keeps jumping around. Every little CB chirp, or a fuel price sign, or just some new idea pops in my head... I get sidetracked. I'm starting to miss details I normally never miss. Like, uh, a client's delivery note, or forgetting who I promised I'd call back. 

So... yeah. That's what finally got me in here.
Have you had a period where you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?
Yeah, I suppose so. Most nights lately I only sleep maybe... three or four hours. But I'm up before daylight. I don't feel worn out or anything, though. Just... ready to roll. That's about it.
Have you been feeling unusually upbeat or euphoric lately?

Euphoric... I don't know about that word. But, uh... I guess I've been pretty fired up for a few months now. Just feeling like everything's gonna work out fine, no matter what. 

But then I also get, well... I've been snapping over small stuff at home. Out in the yard and whatnot. It ain't really my usual way to be like that. So... yeah.
Have you been taking on a lot more projects or activities than usual lately?

Yeah... I suppose. Just finding extra jobs for myself, mostly. Rewriting route plans, or... checking on the new drivers after hours. Doing some fixing up around the house. I just... I get kind of antsy if I sit still too long right now. That's about it.
Have you been doing things lately that are more risky or out of character for you?
Risky? No... I don't think so. I mean, I just do my job and go home. I ain't out doing anything crazy, if that's what you're getting at. Just... regular stuff. That's all.
When you only sleep three or four hours, do you still feel fully rested?
Yeah, I guess so. Most nights I'm only getting about three, maybe four hours. But... I wake up before the sun's even up, and I ain't tired. Just... ready to get going. Don't feel worn out at all.
Do your thoughts ever feel like they’re going too fast for you to keep up with?

No... can't say they do. My head's just... doing its regular thing, I guess. I just focus on what I gotta get done for the day, or the road ahead of me. They ain't going too fast or anything like that.
Have you been drinking more alcohol lately?
No... not really. I mean, I drive for a living, so... I can't really be doing that. Just the usual, if I have anything at all. Nothing more than normal.
Have these changes started causing serious problems at work or at home?

Well... I guess you could say things have been a bit bumpy. Work's... well, I've had to ask dispatch to repeat themselves a few times lately. Lost track of some details I usually wouldn't. And a couple of sales calls just... slipped my mind. I was just thinking about too many other things, I guess. And at home... my wife and daughter, they've been kinda quiet around me. Like they're being careful. I know I'm probably not helping things there right now.
Have you been using any stimulants, like methamphetamine, cocaine, or prescription ADHD pills?
No. I don't touch any of that stuff. Never have. Like I said, I drive a truck. Can't be messing around with things like that.
Before these past few months, have you ever had another time in your life when you only needed a few hours of sleep and still felt fully rested?
No, I... I don't think so. Usually, I'm a guy who needs his solid eight hours. This... not needing sleep thing, it's just been lately. Never really had that happen before.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to notice?
No. I... no. Nothing like that. Just regular stuff.
Lately, have you felt more confident or capable than usual?

I guess so. I mean... I had this idea lately. I figured I could just... rebuild the whole driver training program for the company. Do it all myself. Thought I could make it run a lot better than the bosses ever could. Which, you know... I just drive. It's not really my lane to be doing all that. But I just felt like I could do it no problem.
During these past few months, have you also had stretches where you felt down or depressed most of the day?
No. I... I wouldn't say that. I haven't really felt down or anything. Just... been going about my business, mostly.
Before all this started, did you have a head injury?
No. I haven't... no head injuries. Nothing like that.
Before these changes started, were you diagnosed with any new medical condition?
No. No new conditions. My health's been fine. Just the usual, really.
Have these changes gotten so severe that you’ve been unable to do your job or carry out your usual responsibilities?

I wouldn't say unable. I'm still doing my job. Just... maybe slipped up a little bit. I've had to ask dispatch and a few clients to repeat details I normally keep track of. Dropped the ball on a couple of sales follow-ups because I was... just chasing too many ideas at once, I guess. 

And at home, it's... well, my wife and daughter are kind of walking on eggshells. I can tell I'm adding strain there when I should be helping. But I'm still working.
Have you been told you have a thyroid problem?
No. Nobody's ever said anything about my thyroid.
Before these changes started, did you have a seizure?
No. No seizures. Just the usual stuff, like I said.
